hints.title: Matrix Position Pre-indexing
hints.text: Map each number from 1 to m*n to its exact coordinates (r, c) within the matrix.

hints.title: Row and Column Paint Counters
hints.text: Maintain arrays rowCount of size m and colCount of size n initialized to zero.

hints.title: First Complete Threshold
hints.text: As each element of arr is painted, increment its row and column counters. Stop when rowCount reaches n or colCount reaches m.

hints.title: Row-Column Counter Implementation

complexity.notes: Pre-indexing positions followed by single pass array inspection.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning full matrix on every painted element takes O((m * n)^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) position map and counter arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes coordinate lookups to achieve linear O(m * n) total complexity.
